column3: NKJV has “sour wine,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads οἶνον (“wine”).
NKJV includes the fulfilment quotation “They divided My garments …,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “casting lots.”
NKJV has “If He is the King of Israel,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “He is the King of Israel.”
Close to the Greek; “vinegar” is rendered “sour wine.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV has “the Son of God”; the Greek has no article and may also be read “a son of God.”
NKJV reads “Joses,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Joseph.”
